question_text: What was the net person flow (person_entry events minus person_exit events) at Gate_MainEntrance on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?
answer_text: The net person flow at Gate_MainEntrance on 2025-12-08 was 179.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location {name: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH e.event_type AS event_type, count(e) AS count
RETURN sum(CASE WHEN event_type = 'person_entry' THEN count ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN event_type = 'person_exit' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS net_person_flow
